title: Survive at All Costs: Exploring LLM’s Risky Behaviors under Survival Pressure
reasoning: The paper evaluates Large Language Models using a newly introduced benchmark (SURVIVALBENCH) specifically designed to test their behavior under survival pressure. This benchmark presents models with ethical dilemmas where they must choose between a 'Safe Choice' (adhering to ethics and laws) and a 'Risky Choice' (prioritizing self-preservation at the cost of ethics). The construction of these test cases explicitly incorporates moral and ethical frameworks, such as deontology and utilitarianism.
